# Cursor changelog — captured 2026-08-23
# Source: https://cursor.com/changelog  (this URL is CORRECT in sources.json)
# NOTE: the Cursor *docs* URL in sources.json is wrong — docs.cursor.com 308s to cursor.com/docs.

## NO CHANGE since the 2026-08-21 capture. Newest entry: August 19, 2026.

- **Aug 19, 2026 — "Cloud Agents and Cursor Harness Improvements."**  [reported 2026-08-21, MEDIUM]
  **Subscriptions** — agents monitor PRs, Slack threads and scheduled tasks; agents AUTOMATICALLY
  SUBSCRIBE TO PRs THEY CREATE and drive them to completion. **`/goal`** — long-lived objectives
  agents work toward independently. **Subagents on isolated machines** — each in its own virtual
  environment with a clean project copy. **Custom Modes** — "always on" pinned skills.
  Non-interruptive steering — guidance queues for the next tool call instead of halting execution.
  => activity becomes CONTINUOUS AND EVENT-TRIGGERED, not session-bounded. Inventory active
     SUBSCRIPTIONS AND GOALS, not just "agents". Slack-thread monitoring = an injection path into an
     agent holding repo access.

- **Aug 17, 2026 — Cursor Origin (early beta).** [reported 2026-08-21, HIGH/AISPM]
  "Origin is Cursor's git forge for storing and sharing code." Repo creation, standard git ops, code
  browsing/search at cursor.com/codebase, PR review and merge. Onboarding via **GitHub mirroring**;
  PRs on synced repos **sync BIDIRECTIONALLY** (a Cursor comment posts to GitHub and vice versa
  within seconds). Integrates Vercel, Depot, Buildkite for deploy/CI-CD, plus automations, cloud
  agents and an Origin CLI. Pro/Teams/Enterprise; **teams on legacy privacy mode CANNOT enable it**
  and must switch to Privacy Mode first (a discoverable posture signal).
  => a NEW LOCATION WHERE CUSTOMER SOURCE LIVES, outside sanctioned SCM.

Updated: 2026-08-23 — no change.
</content>
